decision.explanation: The original Danger Mouse TV series was first released on 28 September 1981, as stated in multiple original sources (D1S4, D2S5, D3S2, etc.). This is the correct answer for the original release of the 1981 series. The other dates—1 April 1975 and 28 September 2015—refer either to a conflicting claim (1975) or to the reboot (2015), which are distinct from the original 1981 series.
